# Mary Stubbs

## Overview

- **Age:** 12 to 14 years old  <sub>[v5 c5 P15](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0015), [v5 c8 P0](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0000)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v5 c5 P11](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0011)</sub>
- **Status:** Living  <sub>[v5 c35 P0](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0000)</sub>
- **Origin:** Hopetown Asylum  <sub>[v5 c5 P51](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0051)</sub>
- **Role:** Bound girl, domestic servant, and student  <sub>[v5 c5 P11](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0011), [v5 c5 P51](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0051), [v5 c9 P44](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0044)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Redheaded snippet  <sub>[v5 c3 P3](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0003), [v5 c4 P40](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0040)</sub>; Belinda the Fourth  <sub>[v5 c5 P38](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0038)</sub>

## Appearance

Mary Stubbs is a small, slender girl with a shriveled, freckled face, a very wide mouth, a snub nose, and long, limp flaxen-colored braids tied with blue ribbon bows. She has unusual, glowing pale-blue eyes bordered by a thin black circle around each iris, along with even, white teeth. Initially dressed in threadbare tartan, she later wears a blue velvet cap with a red rosette, a navy blue cloth coat, and a squirrel fur muff.

_Sources: [v5 c3 P3](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0003), [v5 c5 P3](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0003), [v5 c5 P11](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0011), [v5 c8 P0](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0000)_

## Personality

Mary is an outspoken, defiant, and lively girl who is not easily intimidated. Hardened by a rough upbringing, she is practical and unbothered by her past hardships, often boasting about her endurance and bad experiences rather than seeking pity. Though prone to impudence, swearing, and telling tall tales, she possesses a fierce loyalty, a deep capacity for affection toward those who treat her well, and a strong work ethic. She also harbors a hidden fear of ghosts and divine retribution.

_Sources: [v5 c5 P8](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0008), [v5 c5 P50](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0050), [v5 c5 P59](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0059), [v5 c5 P96](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0096), [v5 c5 P106](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0106), [v5 c9 P44](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0044), [v5 c10 P0](../source/v05-c10.md#nw-v05-c10-p0000)_

## Goals

- To avoid being sent back to the asylum or an abusive home  <sub>[v5 c5 P42](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0042), [v5 c5 P108](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0108)</sub>
- To be useful and well-behaved for Miss Winifred  <sub>[v5 c5 P56](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0056), [v5 c9 P44](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0044)</sub>
- To own a blue satin dress when she grows up  <sub>[v5 c5 P86](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0086)</sub>

## History

After enduring years of physical abuse and starvation under Mrs. Grimble across the harbor, Mary ran away to Glen St. Agnes after losing her savings. She hid in an old barn for two days until the manse children—Grace, Ida, Tobias, and Rupert Ashdown—discovered her. They fed her and kept her hidden, and she quickly befriended them and the Carrow children, sharing stories and joining their games in Fern Hollow. When Mrs. Grimble suddenly died, freeing Mary from the fear of being returned, Miss Winifred (Mrs. Ambrose Kerr) took her in as a domestic helper and companion. Under Miss Winifred's guidance, Mary blossomed into a hardworking, loyal, and well-clothed young woman, despite occasional mischievous antics and outspokenness. She eventually agreed to attend the local school, formed strong friendships with the village children, and accompanied Miss Winifred when her mistress moved to Portmaris.

_Sources: [v5 c5 P11](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0011), [v5 c5 P22](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0022), [v5 c5 P30](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0030), [v5 c5 P42](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0042), [v5 c5 P88](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0088), [v5 c8 P0](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0000), [v5 c9 P44](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0044), [v5 c9 P45](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0045), [v5 c10 P0](../source/v05-c10.md#nw-v05-c10-p0000), [v5 c11 P0](../source/v05-c11.md#nw-v05-c11-p0000)_

## Background by volume

- Her full name is Mary Martha Lucilla Vane Ball Stubbs, named after six relatives  <sub>[v5 c5 P53](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0053)</sub>
- Orphaned at six years old after her parents died due to alcoholism  <sub>[v5 c5 P51](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0051), [v5 c5 P53](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0053)</sub>
- Spent two years at Hopetown Asylum before being bound out at eight years old to the abusive Mrs. Grimble  <sub>[v5 c5 P51](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0051)</sub>
- Endured four years of physical abuse and overwork at Mrs. Grimble's farm  <sub>[v5 c5 P11](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0011), [v5 c5 P35](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0035)</sub>
